rule: Every row runs through the adapter and the installed engine in scripts/blueprint-floor-matrix.test.mjs; each engine sentence in contract.md, whitelist.json, protocol.md and the pre-registration limits cites the rows that back it.

rows.name: dep-prose-md

input.patch:
diff --git a/docs/a.md b/docs/a.md
new file mode 100644
--- /dev/null
+++ b/docs/a.md
@@ -0,0 +1,1 @@
+Call require('lodash') here.

rows.note: forbiddenDependency fires on a require() written in plain prose in a changed markdown file (via .floor files)

rows.name: dep-prose-apostrophe

input.patch:
diff --git a/docs/a.md b/docs/a.md
new file mode 100644
--- /dev/null
+++ b/docs/a.md
@@ -0,0 +1,1 @@
+Don't call require('lodash') here.

rows.note: an earlier apostrophe opens a string for the TypeScript lexer, so the same prose after it does not fire
